rules.statement: A person in the position of an agent is generally treated by English law as an express trustee, and thus cannot plead the benefit of the Prescription Ordinance under section 111(5) of the Trusts Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "that, inasmuch as a person in the position of an agent is generally treated by English law as an express trustee, the provisions of section 111 (5) of the Trusts Ordinance precluded the defendant from pleading the benefit of the Prescription Ordinance."

meta.parties: Mohamed Et Al. v. Abdul Gafoor
